## Feature summary

Describe the feature or improvement you would like to see in LiveCamForge.

## Problem or use case

What problem would this solve, or what use case would it support?

## Proposed solution

Describe how you think the feature could work.

You do not need to provide a technical implementation.

## Area

Which part of LiveCamForge would this affect?

- [ ] Public catalog / frontend
- [ ] Admin interface
- [ ] Provider integration
- [ ] Affiliate / conversion tracking
- [ ] Synchronization / cron
- [ ] Installation / upgrade
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Developer experience
- [ ] Other

## Alternatives considered

Have you considered another way to solve the same problem?

## Additional context

Add examples, screenshots, mockups or other information that may help explain the idea.
